subject: Renewal: Hearth & Harbor — staged commit & price-hold proposal
messages:
From: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@hearthharbor.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evan Liu <evan.liu@hearthharbor.com>, procurement@hearthharbor.com
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal & capacity — upcoming term

Jordan — thanks for the check-in. Our renewal is up Feb 1 and I wanted to flag a few constraints from procurement and finance before we get too deep on terms.

1) Budget is tighter than expected for H1; the CFO has signaled that we need a price hold for at least the first two quarters of the new term.
2) We see strong growth in conversational queries coming out of the checkout flows — forecasted 35% QoQ growth — but procurement wants a staged commit rather than an immediate step-up.
3) Legal will need ~60 days to review any amended SOW / T&Cs.

Can Redwood propose a renewal that: (A) preserves our current unit price for 6 months (price hold), (B) includes a bridge/credits to cover expected overage in Q1 while we ramp, and (C) a staged commit that lets us step up once legal signs off?

I've attached our current usage summary and a Q4 forecast so you can see the ramp profile.

Thanks — happy to set a 30-min call this week.

— Sofia Ramos
Head of Engineering
Hearth & Harbor

Attachment: current_usage_summary.csv (summary, 34 KB)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@hearthharbor.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 11:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal & capacity — upcoming term

Hi Sofia — thanks for the context and the forecast. Appreciate the heads-up on legal and the CFO runway. We can absolutely work toward a staged commit + temporary price hold. High-level idea below — happy to iterate: 

- 12-month renewal with a 6-month price hold at your current MSRP for the tokens rate (no upstream price increases for months 1–6).
- Staged commit: base committed usage of 1.2M tokens/month months 1–3, then step to 1.8M tokens/month months 4–12.
- Bridge credit: $35,000 one-time credit to offset Q1 overages while you ramp.
- If you hit the month-4 step target ahead of schedule, we’ll apply a pro-rated uplift credit toward dedicated capacity purchase (if you choose Dedicated later).

I attached a short proposal (staged_commit_proposal_v1.pdf) that spells out the numbers. If that looks directionally right, can we do a short call Wednesday to align on procurement timeline and get legal on the SOW path?

Marissa / Ben — any concerns from pricing/finance on the bridge credit and staged commit structure?

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive — Redwood Inference

Attachment: staged_commit_proposal_v1.pdf (PDF, 72 KB)

Jordan — thanks, that outline is helpful and directionally what we had in mind. Two clarifications: 

- Our projected midterm ramp would need the month-4 step to be to 2.0M tokens/month (our engineering forecast shows a faster checkout rollout).
- Procurement needs the bridge credit as a dollar offset against the first two invoices rather than a token credit.

Legal will start its 60-day review on Nov 10. Procurement prefers all commercial terms to be locked before legal completes redline so they can finalize budget sign-off.

I've uploaded the Q4 forecast for detail — the peak weeks in late Dec/early Jan are what drives the first-quarter pressure.

If you can put together a concrete term sheet (numbers and invoice treatment for the bridge credit), I can run that with procurement and Evan (CFO).

— Sofia

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Jordan / Neha — looping in pricing to nail the numbers so we can get a term sheet to them before Nov 10. Key constraints: 60-day legal, bridge credit must be invoice offset, customer wants a slightly larger step at month 4. Proposed commercial below (we should confirm with Finance):

PROPOSED TERMS (internal draft)
- Term: 12 months (Feb 1, 2027 — Jan 31, 2028)
- Price hold: current token price (no change) for months 1–6
- Commit schedule: month 1–3 = 1.2M tokens / month; month 4–12 = 2.0M tokens / month
- Discounts: 20% off MSRP applied to committed volume months 1–3; 10% discount months 4–12
- Bridge credit: $35,000 applied as invoice credits split across first two invoices (invoice 1 = $17,500 credit; invoice 2 = $17,500 credit)
- Early upsell incentive: an additional $25,000 credit if Hearth & Harbor signs Dedicated capacity within 6 months (applied to Dedicated invoice)
- Overage: billed at locked-in unit price (no surcharge) but counted toward monthly commit; if they exceed commit by >25% for two consecutive months, we trigger a usage review and potential uplift discussion (friendly advisory).

Ben — finance approval needed on bridge credit and the Dedicated incentive. If you sign off, Jordan can send an agreed term sheet and I’ll prepare an amended SOW draft for legal to review.

Jordan — recommend 30-min call with Sofia + procurement on Friday to lock timing. I’ll be on the call.

— Marissa Cole
Director, Revenue Strategy — Redwood Inference
